items.exampleEn: I don't earn much, but I get by.
items.exampleZh: 我賺得不多，但還過得去。

items.exampleEn: Phones kept going off during the concert.
items.exampleZh: 音樂會進行時，手機鈴聲一直響起。

items.exampleEn: She hung up before I could say anything.
items.exampleZh: 我還來不及說話，她就掛了電話。

items.exampleEn: Is this bus heading for downtown?
items.exampleZh: 這班公車是開往市中心的嗎？

items.exampleEn: Most disagreements can be ironed out over a cup of coffee.
items.exampleZh: 大部分的意見不合都能邊喝咖啡邊解決。

items.exampleEn: He kept on talking during the movie.
Let's kick the meeting off with some good news.
items.exampleZh: 我們用一些好消息來開始這場會議吧。

items.sentenceEn: If you keep on practicing, you'll get better.
items.sentenceZh: 只要你持續練習，就會進步。

items.audioEn: Right now we're heading for the airport, so we'll call you when we land.
items.audioZh: 我們現在正在去機場的路上，降落後會打電話給你。
options: Waiting to get on the plane at the gate

items.sentenceEn: Let's iron the problems out before the launch.
items.sentenceZh: 我們在上市前先把問題解決吧。

items.sentenceEn: This milk smells like it has gone off.
items.sentenceZh: 這牛奶聞起來好像已經壞掉了。

items.stemEn: When the caller started shouting at me, I ____.
items.stemZh: 打電話來的人開始對我大吼時，我就掛了電話。

items.stemEn: The new football season will ____ next weekend with its first match.
items.stemZh: 新的足球季將在下週末以第一場比賽揭開序幕。

items.passageEn: Our company trip kicks off next Friday. We will head for the mountains early in the morning and stay in a small hotel for two nights. There is no shop near the hotel, so everyone should bring enough snacks to get by for the weekend. The organizers are still ironing out a few details, such as who will share rooms. Please check your messages often, because they may send updates.
items.passageZh: 我們公司的員工旅遊下週五開始。我們一早會前往山區，在一間小旅館住兩晚。旅館附近沒有商店，所以每個人都要帶足夠撐過週末的零食。主辦人還在處理一些細節，例如誰和誰住同一間房。請常常查看訊息，因為他們可能會傳來最新消息。

questions.questionZh: 為什麼大家要自己帶零食？
options: 主辦單位只準備了早餐和午餐
午餐要在哪一家餐廳吃
出發的時間要改到幾點

items.promptZh: 我的鬧鐘今天早上沒有響。
referenceEn: My alarm didn't go off this morning.
This morning, my alarm clock didn't go off.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「響」（例如 didn't go off 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 didn't ring、didn't sound 等）
有「今天早上」，用過去式（例如 didn't go off 等）
「鬧鐘」可寫，例如 alarm、alarm clock 等

items.promptZh: 她靠一份兼職工作勉強過活。
referenceEn: She gets by on a part-time job.
She gets by with one part-time job.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「勉強過活」（例如 gets by on 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 survives on、makes a living from 等）
時態可用現在式、現在進行式或過去式（例如 gets by、is getting by、got by 等）
「兼職工作」可寫，例如 a part-time job 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：「離開」是 go off 的另一個常見意思（He went off to work／went off without saying goodbye），當干擾項不妥。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：go off 干擾項「離開」換成「回去」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：「燙衣服」對應 iron out 的字面意思（iron out the creases／wrinkles＝燙平皺褶），學習者選它不算錯，建議換掉。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：iron out 干擾項「燙衣服」（字面義也成立）換成「取消」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：「脫下」對應 kick off 的另一個常見用法（kick off one's shoes＝踢掉／脫下鞋子），當干擾項不妥。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：kick off 干擾項「脫下」（kick off one's shoes）換成「結束」
